subject: english
title: 定语从句
text: Relative clauses modify a noun or pronoun. Restrictive clauses identify the referent; non-restrictive clauses add supplementary information and are set off by commas.
translation: 定语从句修饰名词或代词。限制性定语从句用于确定所指对象；非限制性定语从句补充信息，通常用逗号隔开。

subject: english
title: 非谓语动词
text: Infinitives, gerunds and participles can function as subjects, objects, complements, attributes or adverbials without serving as the finite predicate.
translation: 不定式、动名词和分词不作句子的限定谓语，可充当主语、宾语、补语、定语或状语。

subject: english
title: 名词性从句
text: Subject, object, predicative and appositive clauses function like nouns. The connector depends on meaning and on whether it has a grammatical role inside the clause.
translation: 主语从句、宾语从句、表语从句和同位语从句具有名词功能。连接词取决于句意，以及它是否在从句内部充当成分。

subject: english
title: 虚拟语气
text: The subjunctive presents unreal, hypothetical or desired situations. Conditional forms change according to whether the condition concerns the present, past or future.
translation: 虚拟语气表示非真实、假设或愿望。条件句形式会根据假设针对现在、过去还是将来而变化。

subject: english
title: 倒装与强调
text: Partial inversion places an auxiliary before the subject after certain negative or restrictive expressions. The emphatic pattern is It is or was ... that or who ....
translation: 部分倒装在某些否定或限制性表达之后把助动词置于主语之前。强调句基本结构为 It is/was ... that/who ...。

commonErrors: 强调句与定语从句混淆
